Cricket: Abhishek Sharma Equals Yuvraj Singh's Feat, Suryakumar Yadav Tops Rankings

Abhishek Sharma has matched Yuvraj Singh's record for the fastest T20 half-century by an Indian player, achieving the milestone in 22 balls. Suryakumar Yadav has retained his top position in the ICC T20I batting rankings. Sanju Samson has dropped out of the top 10 in the rankings. The coverage also mentions Shreyas Iyer's plans regarding opening batsmen.
